correctness.rationale: An explicit cubic girth-six graph gives the star-forest bound |X|≤12, and outer/inner closed-neighborhood equations classify the four equality cases. Their geodesic admissibility and mutual intersections follow from graph distances. Full 24-bit and independently enumerated backtracking verifiers rebuild the 192 geodesic obstructions, the 78,860 faces, all facet coefficients, and optimum correspondence. Results are finite, not extrapolations.
